{{Quote|The ice here is as thick as a Gamorrean's skull. A thermal bore melts it fast, for mining or building bases. Set that device in the wrong place, the ice shelf will crack and this base is history.|Felix Iresso|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''thermal bore''' was an ice melting technological device. One unit, powerful enough to crack [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] ice shelf, was stolen by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]].
